evidence.name: Screen field: Highest number on the wheel
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Highest number on the wheel" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Highest number on the wheel
sections.description: The largest number a Range-mode wheel ends at. Together with the 'from' value it sets the span users can scroll — for example from 1 to 10 lets them pick any number from 1 through 10. Keep this higher than 'from', and set it to the largest realistic answer for your question so users aren't offered absurd values.
